note: reel_check (reel-check.md not released). Story type POLICY/people-led (petition). Lead: digest 05:52 Dubai (Kotaku, VGC). gate 02:50Z: primary read, House of Commons e-petition e-7898 (category Business and trade): asks the Government of Canada to 'provide BioWare with the capital necessary to secure independence' and to shield Canadian cultural institutions from foreign corporate control; sponsor Brendan Routh (Burnaby); sponsoring MP Don Davies (Vancouver Kingsway, NDP); 1,316 validated signatures; opened 4 Nov 2026, closes 4 Mar 2027, open for signature. The page does not say what happens at 500 signatures, so no threshold claim; Kotaku's 'tabled and official response' not used. Context (EA closing BioWare, 21 Oct) is verified in the story file 2026-10-21 (EA letter): used only as 'بعد قرار EA إغلاقه'. Hook: Canadian parliament petition to fund BioWare's independence. Why now: opened 4 Nov, passes 1,000 signatures. Players here: a Mass Effect/Dragon Age studio's future.
